description:
Explore one DART filing by receipt number while preserving section and table structure — the main body by default, or one of its attachments (audit reports carry the consolidated statements; the main body carries the business description).

Use get_dart_filings first to obtain rcept_no. Start with action='overview', then select a section or table instead of requesting a long flattened filing. The overview lists the archive's entries (main body + attachments with their first heading); pass entry='<name>' to explore an attachment.

Args:
  - rcept_no: 14-digit DART receipt number
  - entry: archive entry name from the overview's entries list (default: the main body)
  - action: overview (default) | section | table | compare_tables | compare_sections
  - compare_rcept_no and compare_index: second filing and its selected table/section index for comparison; table_index/section_index selects the first. Use both overviews first. Only selected content is compared, not entire filings.
  - section_index or section_query: one section selector for action='section'
  - table_index: 1-based table selector for action='table'
  - max_chars: section text cap, 1,000-100,000 (default 30,000)
  - max_rows/max_columns: selected table caps (defaults 50/30)
  - overview_offset/overview_limit: paginate both section and table summaries with the same 0-based slice (defaults 0/20, max 100)
  - response_format: markdown or json

Returns source evidence for the OpenDART document entry and character range. Tables retain row/column order, cell text, rowspan/colspan and nearby reported unit labels. Zero and negative strings are not discarded. Separate HWP/PDF files are not fetched or rehosted.

This tool does not claim an XBRL presentation/calculation hierarchy. Use get_dart_financials for normalized figures, reported account groups and known statement sum checks.

action.description: Start with the outline, then select a section or a leaf table.

compare_index.description: Table or section index inside the second filing. Read that filing's overview first; table_index/section_index selects the first filing's side.

compare_rcept_no.description: Second filing's 14-digit receipt number, for compare_tables / compare_sections. The first filing is rcept_no.

entry.description: Archive entry to explore, exactly as the overview's entries list names it (e.g. 20260313001021_00761.xml for a consolidated audit report). Omit for the main body. Attachments are read from DART, not from the preserved copy.

fresh.description: false (default): read FinBridge's preserved copy of this filing when we hold one, and DART otherwise. true: fetch the current version from DART now — use only when the user asks for the latest text or suspects a correction.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of selected section text; truncation is explicit.

max_columns.description: Maximum selected table columns; original column count is retained.

max_rows.description: Maximum selected table rows; original row count is retained.

overview_limit.description: Maximum section and table summaries per outline page; follow next_offset.

overview_offset.description: 0-based outline slice offset for both sections and tables.

response_format.description: Readable markdown or JSON; both retain structured content.

section_index.description: 1-based section number from the outline; use only with section action.

section_query.description: Section title search; use instead of section_index. Ambiguous matches are rejected.

table_index.description: 1-based leaf-table number; required for table action.

name: get_dart_document
